dialogue: Unity developer — mobile, WebGL, AR and VR. ~1 year shipping production apps at Hapz Software Solutions.
I enjoy making games, playing games, and talking about game design — catch me livestreaming on YouTube and posting dev content on Instagram!
Hands-on with C#, Unity, ScriptableObjects, PlayFab, AR Foundation, and XR Toolkit — building games and connecting them to real audiences.
Always building and learning — experimenting with 2D platformers, 3D cooking prototypes, multiplayer systems, and XR experiences.
The thought of building great games fills you with DETERMINATION.

highlights: Built gameplay systems and interactive UI using C#, ScriptableObjects, and state machines across commercial Unity applications.
Integrated PlayFab for player authentication (Google, Facebook, Guest), cloud saves, leaderboards, and runtime localization.
Developed interactive AR and VR experiences using AR Foundation and Meta Quest (XR Interaction Toolkit) for training simulations.
Learned multiplayer networking fundamentals with Photon Fusion and Unity Netcode, building prototypes for player sync and lobbies.
Created custom Unity Editor utilities and debugging tools to simplify daily workflows and asset setups.

Shipped 4 educational games for a Montessori children's learning platform (NDA) — titles covered number counting, multiplication, and board-game-style mechanics, built in Unity and C# with WebGL deployment.
Collaborated in agile sprints with game designers, resolved gameplay bugs, and prototyped multiplayer mechanics using Unity Netcode.

professionalWork.title: Teleporto
professionalWork.summary: A polished 2D puzzle experience with player guidance, localized UI, and connected progression systems.
highlights: Built the highlighting system and the complete player UI.
Implemented Google authentication, PlayFab integration, migration work, statistics, and leaderboards.
Created a tutorial system, supported localization, and delivered feedback-driven improvements.

professionalWork.title: AR Globe
professionalWork.summary: An augmented-reality globe explorer that recognizes a physical globe and turns countries into discoverable learning moments.
highlights: Built the full project from scratch, from globe spawning to the final interaction flow.
Created country highlighting with meshes and outlines, plus the complete game UI.
Added country voice-over, satisfying globe rotation and movement, and performance optimization for faster use.

professionalWork.title: Emory Cole
professionalWork.summary: A panoramic detective game inspired by classic point-and-click adventures, built around exploration, clues, and tactile puzzles.
highlights: Built the project from scratch and created a tool for placing hotspots and nodes.
Implemented inventory, point-and-click interaction, panoramic rotation, UI, and object interactions.
Integrated Arcweave and built two puzzles: a key-block chest puzzle and a rotating cipher puzzle.

professionalWork.title: Earth Match
professionalWork.summary: A match-3 game improved through bug fixes, clearer onboarding, new power-ups, and performance-focused polish.
highlights: Resolved gameplay bugs and improved the overall feel and reliability of the game.
Built a tutorial system to guide players through core mechanics.
Added new power-ups and optimized existing gameplay systems.

professionalWork.title: Fire and Safety VR
professionalWork.summary: A guided VR fire-safety simulation that teaches users how to assess risk, navigate safely, and operate an extinguisher with the PASS method.
highlights: Built the full project from scratch in a Unity factory environment.
Created guided fire simulation, extinguisher interactions following PASS, multiple extinguisher behaviors, and world-responsive NPCs.
Implemented Quest 3 VR interactions, a waypoint system, instructional UI, alarm reactions, and scoring.

games.title: The Office
games.summary: An original 2D platformer designed and built end-to-end — physics movement, patrol and chase enemy AI, melee combat, collectibles, and a full release on itch.io.
highlights: Designed the concept, mechanics, and level structure from scratch with no tutorial base.
Implemented physics-based character movement, patrol and chase AI with NavMesh pathfinding, melee combat with hit detection, and collectible systems.
Built modular gameplay systems with clean animation state machines, a custom debugging overlay, and sprite rendering optimized for consistent 60 FPS.

games.title: Lunar Lander 2D
games.summary: Extended from Code Monkey's Lunar Lander course — took the tutorial base (fuel, scoring pads, Cinemachine, particles) and rebuilt the architecture into a cleaner modular system.
highlights: Base: Code Monkey's Lunar Lander course (fuel management, scoring pads, Cinemachine camera, particle effects, audio, level progression).
Simple addition: persistent high-score system saved across sessions with PlayerPrefs.
Intermediate addition: procedural asteroid obstacle spawner with difficulty scaling across levels; refactored codebase into a modular separated-concern architecture beyond the tutorial.

games.title: GetCooked 3D
games.summary: Extended from Code Monkey's Kitchen Chaos course — rebuilt the data layer with a ScriptableObject-driven recipe system, pause/settings screen, and runtime input rebinding not present in the course.
highlights: Base: Code Monkey's Kitchen Chaos course (object pickup, recipe logic, order delivery, counter interactions).
Simple addition: pause menu and settings screen with master volume and SFX controls.
Intermediate addition: replaced hardcoded recipe logic with a fully data-driven ScriptableObject recipe database + C# Events, and added runtime input rebinding.

games.title: BubbleCore
games.summary: An arcade shooter experiment exploring projectile physics and rapid input responsiveness.
highlights: Fast-paced arcade experiment testing bullet trajectory calculations and state handling.
